name: coding_regions
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: CDS and stop_codon rows of protein_coding transcripts (every transcript) on the 25 canonical contigs, each widened by 8 bp on both sides, then merged per gene_id where they overlap or touch (gaps-and-islands over a running max). One row per merged interval per gene: an allele inside two overlapping genes joins twice, once per gene, which is the honest shape. Contigs are written bare to match the delivered VCF. n_cds counts the source rows in the island; n_transcripts the distinct transcripts. 2,977,130 CDS rows in, 223,048 intervals out covering 44,609,568 bp.

inputs.name: Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gtf.gz
inputs.role: the gene models: which bases are coding, per transcript

licence: Ensembl gene annotation is free of restrictions for any use; see https://www.ensembl.org/info/about/legal/disclaimer.html. Cite Ensembl 2025 (PMID 39656687) for the gene models.
patient_data: none. Public gene models only: a contig, two coordinates, a gene symbol and a stable id per row. Nothing here was derived from the callset.
note: 223,048 merged coding intervals over 19,750 protein-coding genes, ±8 bp splice flank. Deep-intronic and UTR variants fall outside these intervals by construction; a scan restricted to this table cannot see them.
